function cleanMatricol(value) {
  return String(value || "").trim().replace(/\s+/g, "").toUpperCase();
}

function formatStudentYear(value) {
  const v = String(value || "").trim().toUpperCase();
  if (v === "I" || v === "1" || v === "AN I" || v === "ANUL I") return "Anul I";
  if (v === "II" || v === "2" || v === "AN II" || v === "ANUL II") return "Anul II";
  return value ? String(value) : "";
}

function buildStudentGroupLabel(student) {
  if (!student) return "";
  const parts = [];
  if (student.seria) parts.push("Seria " + student.seria);
  if (student.grupa) parts.push("Grupa " + student.grupa);
  return parts.join(" · ");
}

const STUDENT_BY_MATRICOL = STUDENT_REGISTRY.reduce((acc, s) => {
  const key = cleanMatricol(s.matricol);
  if (key) acc[key] = {
    ...s,
    matricol: cleanMatricol(s.matricol),
    year: s.an || "",
    yearLabel: formatStudentYear(s.an),
    group: buildStudentGroupLabel(s),
    spec: formatStudentYear(s.an)
  };
  return acc;
}, {});

function findStudentByMatricol(matricol) {
  return STUDENT_BY_MATRICOL[cleanMatricol(matricol)] || null;
}

function buildStudentIdentity(student) {
  return {
    type:"student_identity_v1",
    matricol:cleanMatricol(student?.matricol),
    name:String(student?.name||""),
    year:String(student?.year||student?.an||""),
    yearLabel:String(student?.yearLabel||formatStu

function loadNomenclator() {
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem("igiena_nomenclator");
    return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : DEFAULT_NOMENCLATOR;
  } catch(e) { return DEFAULT_NOMENCLATOR; }
}
function saveNomenclator(n) {
  localStorage.setItem("igiena_nomenclator", JSON.stringify(n));
}

function activityPlanForSize(target){
  const size=Math.min(14,Math.max(6,Number(target)||14));
  const extraCount=size-6;
  const middle=[...ACTIVITY_REQUIRED_MIDDLE,...ACTIVITY_ADDITIONAL_MIDDLE.slice(0,extraCount)]
    .sort((a,b)=>ACTIVITY_DISPLAY_ORDER.indexOf(a)-ACTIVITY_DISPLAY_ORDER.indexOf(b));
  return [ACTIVITY_SLOT_LIBRARY.coordinator,...middle.map(k=>ACTIVITY_SLOT_LIBRARY[k]),ACTIVITY_SLOT_LIBRARY.reporter];
}

function activityNameKey(value){
  return String(value||"").trim().toLocaleLowerCase("ro-RO").replace(/\s+/g," ");
}

function activityMatricolKey(value){
  return String(value||"").trim().replace(/\s+/g,"").toUpperCase();
}

function activityStudentKey(student){
  const matricol=activityMatricolKey(student?.matricol);
  return matricol?"matricol:"+matricol:"name:"+activityNameKey(student?.name);
}

function activityRowKey(row){
  const marker=String(row?.module_title||"").match(/\|\|MID:([A-Z0-9_-]+)/i);
  return marker?"matricol:"+activityMatricolKey(marker[1]):"name:"+activityNameKey(row?.name);
}

function activityStudentMeta(student){
  return {
    matricol:activityMatricolKey(student?.matricol),
    name:String(student?.name||""),
    year:String(student?.year||student?.an||""),
    yearLabel:String(student?.yearLabel||""),
    seria:String(student?.seria||""),
    officialGroup:String(student?.officialGroup||student?.grupa||""),
    academicGroup:String(student?.academicGroup||""),
  };
}

function activityStoredTitle(title,student){
  const matricol=activityMatricolKey(student?.matricol);
  return matricol?String(title||"")+" ||MID:"+matricol:String(title||"");
}

function activityPayload(row){
  try{return JSON.parse(row?.answers_text||"{}");}catch(e){return {};}
}

function activityStudentMeta(student){
  return {
    matricol:activityMatricolKey(student?.matricol),
    name:String(student?.name||""),
    year:String(student?.year||student?.an||""),
    yearLabel:String(student?.yearLabel||""),
    seria:String(student?.seria||""),
    officialGroup:String(student?.officialGroup||student?.grupa||""),
    academicGroup:String(student?.academicGroup||""),
  };
}

function activityStoredTitle(title,student){
  const matricol=activityMatricolKey(student?.matricol);
  return matricol?String(title||"")+" ||MID:"+matricol:String(title||"");
}

function activityPayload(row){
  try{return JSON.parse(row?.answers_text||"{}");}catch(e){return {};}
}

function participantSlot(f,seat,target,lang){
  const safeSeat=Math.max(1,Number(seat)||1);
  const slots=activityPlanForSize(target);
  const plan=slots[Math.min(slots.length-1,safeSeat-1)];
  const role=f.roles[plan.roleIndex]||f.roles[0];
  const evidence=f.evidence||[];
  const privateClue=evidence.length?(evidence[plan.clueIndex%evidence.length]?.text||role.clue):role.clue;
  const qs=f.qs||[];
  const q=qs.length?qs[(safeSeat-1)%qs.length]:{q:lang==="en"?"What is your professional conclusion?":"Care este concluzia dumneavoastră profesională?"};
  return {...role,clue:privateClue,focus:lang==="en"?plan.en:plan.ro,question:q.q,questionIndex:qs.length?(safeSeat-1)%qs.length:0};
}

async function saveTeamMissionResult(f,state,scored,student,session,members=[],approvals=[]){

    "DOVEZI: "+selectedEvidence.join(" | "),
    "ACȚIUNI: "+selectedActions.join(" | "),

    memberText,
    "--- SINTEZA GRUPULUI ---",
    answerText,
  ].join("\n");

    type:"group_activity_v3",activityId:f.id,activityTitle:f.title,
    verdict:f.diagnosis.options[state.diagnosisChoice]||"—",
    evidence:selectedEvidence,actions:selectedActions,confidence:state.confidence||0,
    sources:f.sourceRefs||[],approvedBy:approvals.map(r=>r.name).filter(Boolean),
    members:members.map(m=>{const p=m.payload||{},meta=p.studentMeta||{};return {seat:m.seat,name:meta.name||m.row?.name||"—",matricol:meta.matricol||"",yearLabel:meta.yearLabel||meta.year||"",seria:meta.seria||"",officialGroup:meta.officialGroup||"",role:p.roleName||"Rol",roleIcon:p.roleIcon||"",focus:p.focus||"",clue:p.clue||"",question:p.question||"",verdict:f.diagnosis.options[p.verdictChoice]||"—",clueClass:p.clueClass||"—",analysis:p

on buildStudentGroupLabel(student) {
  if (!student) return "";
  const parts = [];
  if (student.seria) parts.push("Seria " + student.seria);
  if (student.grupa) parts.push("Grupa " + student.grupa);
  return parts.join(" · ");
}

const STUDENT_BY_MATRICOL = STUDENT_REGISTRY.reduce((acc, s) => {
  const key = cleanMatricol(s.matricol);
  if (key) acc[key] = {
    ...s,
    matricol: cleanMatricol(s.matricol),
    year: s.an || "",
    yearLabel: formatStudentYear(s.an),
    group: buildStudentGroupLabel(s),
    spec: formatStudentYear(s.an)
  };
  return acc;
}, {});

function findStudentByMatricol(matricol) {
  return STUDENT_BY_MATRICOL[cleanMatricol(matricol)] || null;
}

function buildStudentIdentity(student) {
  return {
    type:"student_identity_v1",
    matricol:cleanMatricol(student?.matricol),
    name:String(student?.name||""),
    year:String(student?.year||student?.an||""),
    yearLabel:String(student?.yearLabel||formatStudentYear(student?.year||student?.an||"")),
    seria:String(student?.seria||""),
    grupa:String(student?.officialGroup||student?.grupa||""),
    academicGroup:String(student?.academicGroup||""),
  };
}

function parseStudentIdentity(text) {
  try {
    const parsed=JSON.parse(String(text||"{}"));
    return parsed?.type==="student_identity_v1"?parsed:{};
  } catch(e) { return {}; }
}

function buildExamMeta(meta) {
  try { return "EXAM_META:" + JSON.stringify(meta || {}); } catch(e) { return "EXAM_META:{}"; }
}

function parseExamMeta(text) {
  const raw = String(text || "");
  const idx = raw.indexOf("EXAM_META:");
  if (idx === -1) return {};
  const jsonText = raw.slice(idx + "EXAM_META:".length).trim();
  try { return JSON.parse(jsonText); } catch(e) { return {}; }
}

function isExamResult(r) {
  return !!(r && (
    String(r.labCode || "").includes("-EXAM") ||
    String(r.module || "").includes("exam") ||
    String(r.moduleTitle || "").toLowerCase().includes("examen")
  ));
}

// Live presentation events use the existing results table as a lightweight
// synchronized classroom channel. They are hidden from assessed results.
async function loadLiveClassEvents(token) {
  if (!token) return [];
  const res = await sb(`results?session_id=eq.${encodeURIComponent(token)}&select=*&order=created_at.asc&limit=1000`);
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Sesiunea live nu a putut fi sincronizată.");
  const rows = await res.json();
  return rows.map(row=>{
    let payload={};
    try { payload=JSON.parse(row.answers_text||"{}"); } catch(e) {}
    return {...row,payload,timestamp:new Date(row.created_at).getTime()};
  }).filter(row=>row.payload?.type==="live_class_v1");
}

    const st = findStudentByMatricol(clean);

    const questions = pickExamQuestions(20, lang);
